## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: HYG/LQD credit-stress signal flagged (CREDIT STRESS ↓) and Cyclical vs Defensive weakening (0.6750, 1W: -4.04% ↓ falling) while SPY in CORRECTION (1W: -0.44% | 1M: +2.78%) adds market vulnerability; note VXX declining (1W: -2.06% | 1M: -10.86%) BELOW TREND is a conflicting, complacent signal.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress signal showing deterioration (HYG (1W: +0.13% | 1M: +0.56%) ABOVE TREND; LQD (1W: +0.42% | 1M: +0.17%) ABOVE TREND) while the regime metric flags CREDIT STRESS ↓; Fear easing: VXX (1W: -2.06% | 1M: -10.86%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND. Safe-haven bid visible as GLD (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.41%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +1.61% | 1M: +13.06%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Dollar weakening: UUP (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -2.11%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND; long-duration bonds showing RECOVERY with TLT (1W: +1.11% | 1M: -0.37%) RECOVERY and SPY/TLT in CORRECTION (1W: -1.65% | 1M: +3.00%) ↓ falling — conditions uneven for risk assets.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Healthcare leading: XLV (1W: +4.30% | 1M: +9.63%) ABOVE TREND and Energy strong: XLE (1W: +4.18% | 1M: +8.68%) ABOVE TREND; Tech lagging in CORRECTION with XLK (1W: -2.76% | 1M: +1.58%) CORRECTION and Financials soft: XLF (1W: -0.83% | 1M: +2.61%) CORRECTION — style mixed, no clean growth leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US equities mixed with SPY (1W: -0.44% | 1M: +2.78%) CORRECTION; China outperforming: FXI (1W: +1.28% | 1M: +3.03%) ABOVE TREND while EM via EEM (1W: -0.53% | 1M: +1.18%) CORRECTION — regional dispersion elevated.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative flows present: IBIT (1W: +8.05% | 1M: +2.95%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +2.38% | 1M: +7.23%) ABOVE TREND, while small caps show only a modest RECOVERY: IWM (1W: -0.33% | 1M: +1.75%) CORRECTION.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Precious metals strong: GLD (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.41%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +1.61% | 1M: +13.06%) ABOVE TREND; industrial commodities mixed with CPER (1W: -1.57% | 1M: -0.35%) BELOW TREND indicating softer cyclical demand.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy rally intact: XLE (1W: +4.18% | 1M: +8.68%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +3.15% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND, while natural gas remains weak: UNG (1W: -1.86% | 1M: -3.75%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Energy and Healthcare (XLE and XLV) ABOVE TREND across 1W and 1M. DIVERGENCE: MAJOR DIVERGENCE present — SPY, XLK, XLF and TLT show 1W vs 1M mismatches, which mutes conviction around the RISK-OFF label and signals a transitional environment.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor GLD (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.41%) ABOVE TREND, XLE (1W: +4.18% | 1M: +8.68%) ABOVE TREND and XLV (1W: +4.30% | 1M: +9.63%) ABOVE TREND for relative strength; reduce exposure to tech beta as XLK (1W: -2.76% | 1M: +1.58%) CORRECTION and monitor bond volatility with TLT (1W: +1.11% | 1M: -0.37%) RECOVERY.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Healthcare XLV (1W: +4.30% | 1M: +9.63%) ABOVE TREND, Energy XLE (1W: +4.18% | 1M: +8.68%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Technology XLK (1W: -2.76% | 1M: +1.58%) CORRECTION, Semiconductors SOXX (1W: -4.93% | 1M: -5.97%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Gold GLD (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.41%) ABOVE TREND, Silver SLV (1W: +1.61% | 1M: +13.06%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Copper CPER (1W: -1.57% | 1M: -0.35%) BELOW TREND, Natural Gas UNG (1W: -1.86% | 1M: -3.75%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold) with VXX (1W: -2.06% | 1M: -10.86%) BELOW TREND; HYG/LQD credit-health pivot ~0.80 (monitor HYG (1W: +0.13% | 1M: +0.56%) ABOVE TREND, LQD (1W: +0.42% | 1M: +0.17%) ABOVE TREND); XLK/XLF ratio ~3.20 (tech vs financials pivot) with XLK (1W: -2.76% | 1M: +1.58%) CORRECTION and XLF (1W: -0.83% | 1M: +2.61%) CORRECTION.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. GLD (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.41%) ABOVE TREND, XLV (1W: +4.30% | 1M: +9.63%) ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +4.18% | 1M: +8.68%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: major 1W vs 1M divergences across SPY, XLK, XLF and TLT and a flagged credit-stress signal (HYG/LQD) — monitor for regime tipping.
